procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Magda Resano (Spain coach) attended the hearing as an observer.
José Kiio Miranda (member of the international jury) attended the hearing as interpreter for ESP 56971.
ESP 56971 was represented by Amalia Coll Company.
GRE 56946 was represented by Andreas Psomiadis.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident in race 7 of the 420 U17 Gold fleet were 10 knots of wind and less than 1 metre waves.
One minute after the start of race 7 ESP 56971, FRA 56985 and GRE 56946 were sailing on starboard tack.
GRE 56946 was two metres clear ahead of FRA 56985, which was slightly to windward. GRE 56946 was two and a half boat lengths clear ahead of ESP 56971, which was slightly to windward of FRA 56985.
GRE 56946 tacked onto port tack and crossed ahead of FRA 56985.
From the time GRE 56946 completed her tack to the point where she cleared ESP 56971, ESP 56971 did not change her course.
There was no contact between boats.
conclusions: GRE 56946 on port tack kept clear of ESP 56971 on starboard tack as required by RRS 10.
